Taken alone in another game, any of this game’s elements would stand out. The fact that every element blends so perfectly here makes me confident to say that Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse is the best Metroidvania I’ve ever experienced. It’s sure to go down as an all-time classic.","score":97,"url":"https://www.rpgfan.com/review/castlevania-belmonts-curse/","date":"2026-10-13","author":"","authorSlug":null,"image":null,"publicationName":"RPG Fan","publicationSlug":"rpg-fan","platform":"PlayStation 5"},{"quote":" Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse is an absolute dream come true for everyone who loves this series. It might be tougher than previous installments, but that is precisely part of its charm.","score":89,"url":"https://gamersrd.com/castlevania-belmonts-curse-review-un-regreso-gotico-y-desafiante/","date":"2026-10-12","author":"","authorSlug":null,"image":null,"publicationName":"GamersRD","publicationSlug":"gamersrd","platform":"PlayStation 5"},{"quote":"After years of absence, Castlevania returns with a bold, challenging Metroidvania that honors its legacy while confidently moving forward.","score":88,"url":"https://as.com/meristation/analisis/analisis-castlevania-belmonts-curse-lagrimas-de-sangre-f202610-n/","date":"2026-10-13","author":"","authorSlug":null,"image":null,"publicationName":"Meristation","publicationSlug":"meristation","platform":"PlayStation 5"},{"quote":"Regardless of what the future holds, the fact that the new Castlevania turned out so well is already cause for celebration. It’s a metroidvania that manages to balance keeping the old-school Castlevania thematic alive and well while simultaneously refining platforming and combat mechanics that haven’t yet been possible. Knowing that Evil Empire, Motion Twin, and Konami are seeking to reimagine the now-40-year-old franchise for new players, it feels like they made a valiant effort to retain what longtime fans love most while giving new players just enough to enjoy a Castlevania title for the first time.","score":87,"url":"https://digitalchumps.com/castlevania-belmonts-curse-ps5-review/","date":"2026-10-13","author":"","authorSlug":null,"image":null,"publicationName":"Digital Chumps","publicationSlug":"digital-chumps","platform":"PlayStation 5"},{"quote":"Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse is a particularly distinctive return for the series, but one that rises to the occasion. Its boss fights are challenging, but also deeply satisfying.","score":85,"url":"https://areajugones.sport.es/videojuegos/analisis-de-castlevania-belmonts-curse-tras-20-horas-puedo-confirmarte-que-este-regreso-guarda-mas-sorpresas-de-las-que-esperas/","date":"2026-10-12","author":"","authorSlug":null,"image":null,"publicationName":"Areajugones","publicationSlug":"areajugones","platform":"PlayStation 5"},{"quote":"After an 18-year hiatus for the vampire-hunting series' traditional style, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse both slakes the thirst of long-time fans and offers an entry point for a new audience. It is an adventure that plays it safe—taking a somewhat understated approach to the Metroidvania elements and facing some limitations—yet its strengths ultimately shine through, making it well worth playing. Here's hoping Rose Belmont's journey breathes new life into the franchise's future—and that the current low-resolution textures get adjusted for 4K screens.","score":85,"url":"https://psxbrasil.com.br/castlevania-belmonts-curse-review/","date":"2026-10-12","author":"","authorSlug":null,"image":null,"publicationName":"PSX Brasil","publicationSlug":"psx-brasil","platform":"PlayStation 5"},{"quote":"Castlevania: Belmont's Curse has all the elements necessary to attract both historical enthusiasts and those looking for a solid, modern Metroidvania. The Parisian setting, the centrality of the whip, the gameplay systems, and the ability to customize combat outline a project that doesn't seek to live solely on nostalgia, but rather clearly shows that a bright future is still possible for the series. This new chapter also demonstrates that there's still room for evolution, and that perhaps the lack of boldness in overhauling was ultimately a wise and correct choice, because what the series needed at this moment in its history was to reaffirm that this familiar and recognizable path is ready to be explored again. Belmont's Curse may not be perfect, but it's undoubtedly very good, and it forcefully reaffirms that Castlevania is still alive and well, ready for a second lease of life.","score":85,"url":"https://www.everyeye.it/articoli/recensione-castlevania-belmont-s-curse-ritorno-saga-vampiresca-konami-67718.html","date":"2026-10-13","author":"","authorSlug":null,"image":null,"publicationName":"Everyeye.it","publicationSlug":"everyeyeit","platform":"PlayStation 5"},{"quote":"After a twelve-year slumber in his coffin, Dracula deserved a comeback worthy of his legend. While the experience is far from innovative or groundbreaking, it is expertly crafted, driven by exemplary exploration and a spellbinding atmosphere. Rose proves she is far more than a mere heir: she has the mettle, the whip, and the grit needed to worthily carry on the lineage of vampire hunters.
